Privacy Policy

Source: vignettes/privacy-policy.Rmd
privacy-policy.Rmd

Last updated: March 2026

Overview

rgoogleslides is an open-source R package that provides a programmatic interface to the Google Slides API. This privacy policy explains what data the package accesses, how it is used, and how it is protected.

What data is accessed

When you authenticate with gs_auth(), the package requests the following OAuth 2.0 scopes on your behalf:

Scope Purpose
https://www.googleapis.com/auth/presentations Read and write Google Slides presentations that you own or have been shared with you
https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive.readonly Read file metadata and download files from Google Drive (used to resolve Drive-hosted image URLs when inserting images into slides)

How data is used

All API calls are made on your behalf using your own Google account credentials. The package:

  • Creates, reads, and modifies Google Slides presentations at your explicit direction (i.e. when you call package functions)
  • Reads Google Drive file metadata only to resolve image URLs when you explicitly insert a Drive-hosted image into a slide

The package does not:

  • Collect, store, or transmit any user data to third parties
  • Access any files or presentations beyond what your R code explicitly requests
  • Run any background or scheduled operations

Where credentials are stored

OAuth tokens are cached locally on your machine in the gargle token cache (typically ~/.cache/gargle/ on Linux/macOS or %APPDATA%\gargle\ on Windows). Tokens are stored only on your own device and are never sent anywhere other than Google’s OAuth servers.

You can remove cached tokens at any time by calling gs_deauth(), or by deleting the gargle cache directory manually.

OAuth client

The package ships with a bundled OAuth 2.0 client registered under the rgoogleslides Google Cloud project. This client credential identifies the application to Google’s consent screen but does not grant access to any user data on its own. You can supply your own OAuth client with gs_auth_configure() if you prefer.

Contact

For questions about this privacy policy or the package’s data practices, please open an issue at https://github.com/eivicent/rgoogleslides/issues.
